observations.Q2: BranchResource silently substitutes the branch's phone number for a missing WhatsApp number ($this->whatsapp_number ?? $this->phone), which contradicts the rest of the change — the column, DTOs and validation all deliberately preserve null — so the API can never report "no WhatsApp", and a client that reads then writes the resource back will persist the phone number as the WhatsApp number.

BranchResource returns whatsapp_number as a silent fallback to phone, so the read path can never express the null that the write path (nullable column, nullable DTO/validation) deliberately supports — a client that reads a branch and submits it back (edit form prefill, PUT/PATCH round trip) permanently persists the phone number into whatsapp_number, and a branch with no WhatsApp is indistinguishable from one that shares the phone.
